messages:
lina: Quick kickoff — we need to wire SSO + KMS + packaging for the pubportal listing. Target: staging assets + legal signoff by EOD Fri. @sam @mike who owns which parts?

mike: I can own AWS infra (S3, IAM, KMS). Need the AWS account for publisher staging and the desired KMS key policy.

sam: Legal will review the listing terms and trial contract. Send SKU, trial length, and any custom onboarding flow. Also: are we collecting telemetry/usage? cc @security

anya: Packaging/devex here — I'll assemble the listing bundle (hero image, screenshots, quickstart, terraform sample). Do we have a required manifest schema? I can draft one; example manifest snippet below:```json
{
  "name": "redwood-inference",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "sku": "redwood-pro-100",
  "trial": {"days": 14, "limits": "1000 tokens/day"},
  "assets": ["hero.png","quickstart.md"],
  "infra": {"awsAccount": "123456789012", "gcpProject": "redwood-marketplay-stg"}
}```

lina: Using AWS acct 123456789012 for staging, GCP project redwood-marketplay-stg, Azure tenant id 0a1b2c3d-xxxx. Branding pack: https://drive.redwood/partnerships/pubportal-branding (images + logos).

mike: I'll provision an encryption key and an S3 bucket tonight. Draft KMS create command:```bash
aws kms create-key --description "pubportal/staging/redwood" --policy file://kms-policy.json
aws s3api create-bucket --bucket rw-pubportal-staging --acl private --region us-west-2
```

mike: Also will create an IAM role for publisher ingestion with limited PutObject permissions and a role external ID. Need @lina to confirm the external ID value.

sam: Legal question — trial telemetry: is it aggregated only or user-identifying? If PII is present we need DPA language and region locking for EU customers.

security: We require telemetry to be pseudonymized by default. If customers opt-in to enhanced telemetry we need an opt-in checkbox in the onboarding flow and KMS key rotation documented.

anya: Noted on telemetry. I'll build the onboarding flow docs to surface the opt-in and link to the DPA. For terraform sample, I'll push a minimal example to the repo and link it in the manifest.

lina: Action items: mike -> infra + KMS policy (ETA: Fri AM). sam -> legal review and EULA edits (ETA: Thu). anya -> packaging + terraform sample (ETA: Thu). I'll update the tracker spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/partnerships/pubportal-onboard (I'll add owners).

mike: I added the initial KMS policy draft to the infra dossier. ping me if you want edits. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll post EULA changes in this thread once compiled.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for listing-bundle-build #3421 — status: queued.

lina: Thanks team — plan is legal signoff Thu, infra in place Fri AM, and candidate listing ready for publisher staging on Mon. Any blockers speak now. :rocket:
